host.note: Python is build tooling and the test/oracle client only; the server, the sandbox and the carrier decoder are native XAX programs (windows-x86_64 PE32+)

change.summary: M3: xax_construct has an implementation. The server copies the `request` value's JSON text verbatim to <work>\construct-request.json, deletes any stale <work>\constructed.xax, and spawns the host-granted native decoder with a fixed three-word argv (`<decoder> <carrier> <store>`) through _spawnv. The store becomes the work directory's current store only after the decoder exits 0 and the file is at least 39 bytes. The grant is XAX_MCP_CONSTRUCT plus XAX_MCP_WORK; it does not need the compiler trio. A carrier is bounded by the 1 MiB arguments limit; a refusal or a missing/absent decoder leaves current.xax exactly as it was.

claim.label: EXECUTED
claim.statement: On this host, the native server's xax_construct copied the committed sandbox carrier into its fixed transport path, spawned the host-granted native decoder with a fixed three-word argv, and reported the verified store's root (7ef7099d...) and size (74 434 B); the store it made current is byte-identical to native/xax-mcp-sandbox-gen0.xax. The same decoder reproduced the new server store (1 103 601 B / sha256 afa5b600... / root 9493014f...) from native/construction_request.json byte for byte, and the pinned builder produced the same bytes. Refusals and missing grants fail closed without touching the current store. The decoder and compiler are uncommitted local prototypes, and construct remains windows-x86_64 only.
